speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned gait and limb ataxia; can you describe exactly how your balance and coordination are affected, and for how long you have noticed these symptoms? Additionally, do you have a known history of conditions like multiple sclerosis, stroke, or alcohol use disorder?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Spinocerebellar Ataxia (SCA). The symptoms of gait and limb ataxia with a specific emphasis on the right side, combined with a lack of reported acute neurological events like stroke or inflammatory signs like MS, strongly suggest a hereditary degenerative cerebellar disorder. Have there been any family members diagnosed with similar walking or coordination issues, or any known genetic conditions in your lineage?
